section.title: org.osgi.service.onem2m
section.para: Service Layer API for oneM2M Specification Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.onem2m; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.onem2m; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

listitem.para: NotificationListener - Interface to receive notification from other oneM2M entities.
ServiceLayer - Primary Interface for an oneM2M application entity to send request and get response to/from other oneM2M entity.

section.title: public abstract NotificationListener
section.para: Interface to receive notification from other oneM2M entities.
Application that receives notification must implement this interface and register to OSGi service registry. No service property is required.

section.title: public abstract void notified(RequestPrimitiveDTO request)
section.para: receive notification.

section.title: public class OneM2MException extends IOException
section.para: General Exception for oneM2M.

section.title: public OneM2MException(String message, int errorCode)
section.para: Construct a OneM2MException with a message and an error code.

section.title: public int getErrorCode()
section.para: Return the error code for the exception.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The error code for the exception.

section.title: public abstract ServiceLayer
section.para: Primary Interface for an oneM2M application entity to send request and get response to/from other oneM2M entity.
It contains low level API and high level API. The only low level method is request() and other methods are categorized as high level API.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public abstract Promise<ResourceDTO> create(String uri, ResourceDTO resource)

formalpara.title: uri
formalpara.para: URI for parent resource of the resource being created.

section.para: create resource

The create() method is a method to create new resource under specified uri. The second argument resource is expression of resource to be generated. The resourceType field of the resourceDTO must be assigned. For other fields depends on resource type. Section 7.4 of TS-00004 specifies the optionalities of the fields.

section.title: public abstract Promise<Boolean> delete(String uri)
section.para: delete resource
delete resource on the URI specified by uri argument.

section.title: public abstract Promise<List<String>> discovery(String uri, FilterCriteriaDTO fc)

formalpara.title: uri
formalpara.para: URI for resource tree to start the search

section.para: find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
Discovery Result Type is kept as blank and default value of target CSE is used for the parameter.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: list of URIs matching the condition specified in fc

section.title: public abstract Promise<List<String>> discovery(String uri, FilterCriteriaDTO fc, DesiredIdentifierResultType drt)

formalpara.title: uri
formalpara.para: URI for resource tree to start the search

section.para: find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
With this method application can specify desired identifier in result

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: list of URIs matching the condition specified in fc

section.title: public abstract Promise<Boolean> notify(String uri, NotificationDTO notification)
section.para: send notification

section.title: public abstract Promise<ResponsePrimitiveDTO> request(RequestPrimitiveDTO request)
section.para: send a request and receive response.

This method allows very raw data type access and it enables all possible message exchanges among oneM2M entities. This is called the low level API. This method allows all possible operation of oneM2M. For the return type, OSGi Promise is used for allowing synchronous and asynchronous calling manner.

section.title: public abstract Promise<ResourceDTO> retrieve(String uri)
section.para: retrieve resource
retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument. This method retrieve all attributes of the resource.

section.title: public abstract Promise<ResourceDTO> retrieve(String uri, List<String> targetAttributes)
section.para: retrieve resource with selected attributes.

retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument. This method retrieve selected attributes by targetAttributes argument. The retrieve() methods are methods to retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument.

section.title: public abstract Promise<ResourceDTO> update(String uri, ResourceDTO resource)
section.para: update resource

The update() method is a method to update resource on the URI specified by uri argument. The resource argument holds attributes to be updated. Attributes not to be updated shall not included in the argument.
